title: Heat and Observed Economic Activity in the Rich Urban Tropics
abstract: We use space- and time-resolved mobility data to assess how heat impacts Singapore, a rich city state and arguably a harbinger of what is to come in the urbanising tropics. Singapore’s offices, factories, malls, buses and trains are widely air conditioned, its public schools less so. We document increased attendance and commuting to workplaces, malls and the more air-conditioned schools on hotter relative to cooler days, particularly by low-income residents with limited use of adaptive technologies at home. Investment by rich cities may attenuate heat’s pervasive negative consequences on productive outcomes, yet this may worsen the climate emergency in the long run.
abstract_zh: 我们利用时空分辨的人员流动数据，评估高温如何影响新加坡。新加坡是一个富裕的城市国家，可以说是城市化热带地区未来图景的先声。新加坡的办公室、工厂、商场、公交车和列车普遍安装了空调，而其公立学校的空调则较少。我们记录到，在较热的日子里，与较凉爽的日子相比，前往工作场所、商场以及空调较好的学校的出行人数和通勤量均有所增加，尤其是家中缺乏适应性设备的低收入居民。富裕城市的投资或许能够减轻高温对生产性结果普遍的负面影响，但从长远看，这可能会加剧气候紧急状况。

title: Fine-Particulate Air Pollution and Behaviorally Inclusive Mortality Impacts of China's Winter Heating Policy, 2013-2018
Willingness to fight on: Environmental quality in dynamic contests
abstract: We show that the prevalence of prolonged tennis contests drops sharply when the ambient environment deteriorates through heat or pollution. We develop a multi‐battle dynamic model to investigate how the disutility from a protracted competition shapes agents' willingness to fight on. Our theory predicts that a poor environment amplifies the momentum of a competitor's head start. We show how model primitives including preferences for environmental amenities can be inferred from battle‐to‐battle transition probabilities. We find that heat and pollution affect incentives to compete strategically. In a contest between equally able rivals at the median prize of $15,100, the value of a head start is $130‐370 higher in a degraded environment compared with a climate‐controlled one.
abstract_zh: 我们发现，当环境因高温或污染而恶化时，长时间网球比赛的出现频率会急剧下降。我们构建了一个多回合动态模型，以研究长时间竞争带来的负效用如何影响参与者继续争斗的意愿。我们的理论预测，恶劣的环境会放大竞争者领先优势的势头。我们展示了如何从逐回合的状态转移概率中推断出模型的基本参数，包括对环境舒适度的偏好。我们发现，高温和污染会影响策略性竞争的激励。在实力相当的对手之间、奖金中位数为15,100美元的比赛中，在退化的环境下，领先一分的价值比在气候可控的环境下高出130至370美元。

title: Adversity-hope hypothesis: Air pollution raises lottery demand in China
abstract: The empirical literature points to a stylized phenomenon of increased demand for hope following adversity. Clotfelter and Cook (1989) suggest that hope is a key sentiment underpinning recreational gambling. Chew and Ho (1994, this journal) offer the view of hope being experienced in lottery products when people enjoy delaying the resolution of uncertainty. Taking air quality as an indicator of subjective well-being, we hypothesize a positive causal relationship between air pollution and lottery sales. We test this hypothesis using data from China and find that air pollution measured by particle concentration increases demand for a popular lottery for which province-level daily sales records exist. The relationship can readily be seen on combining high-frequency, spatially resolved lottery sales and particle pollution data. Our findings support the adversity-hope hypothesis in the context of air quality and lottery sales and point to further tests using other measures of adversity and proxies of demand for hope.
abstract_zh: 实证文献指出，逆境之后人们对希望的需求会增加，这是一种典型化事实。Clotfelter and Cook（1989）认为，希望是休闲性赌博背后的关键情绪。Chew and Ho（1994，本刊）则提出，人们在享受推迟不确定性结果消解的过程时，会在彩票产品中体验到希望。以空气质量作为主观幸福感的指标，我们假设空气污染与彩票销售之间存在正向因果关系。我们利用中国数据检验这一假设，发现以颗粒物浓度衡量的空气污染会提高一种流行彩票的需求，该彩票存在省级日销售记录。将高频、空间分辨的彩票销售数据与颗粒物污染数据结合后，这一关系可以清楚地看到。我们的发现在空气质量与彩票销售的背景下支持了“逆境—希望”假说，并指出了未来使用其他逆境度量和希望需求代理变量进行检验的方向。

title: Declining discount rates in Singapore's market for privately developed apartments
Evidence of the environmental Kuznets curve for atmospheric pollutant emissions in Southeast Asia and implications for sustainable development: A spatial econometric approach
abstract: Southeast Asia has one of the fastest rates of industrialisation and urbanisation in the world. While this has brought economic benefits to the region, it has also resulted in considerable environmental and health impacts associated with air pollution. This study presents the first spatial econometric assessment of the environmental Kuznets curve (EKC) for Southeast Asia. Spatial panels, while important in studies involving geographical units, have, to date, been underutilised in many EKC studies. In this study, the income–pollution trajectories of three air pollutants—nitrogen oxides (NOx), sulphur dioxide (SO2) and fine particulate matter (PM2.5)—are examined through standard and spatial EKC models that regress per capita emissions on several socioeconomic indicators. The econometric assessment utilises data from 1993 to 2012 for nine Southeast Asian countries at varying levels of economic development. An inverted U‐shaped curve is found for all pollutants, thus confirming the existence of an EKC. Spatial spillovers are not found for NOx emissions but are supported for SO2 and PM2.5 emissions. While an EKC is supported, most countries are still on the upward sloping portion of the inverted U‐shaped curve. This highlights the urgent need to establish and enforce effective policies to abate emissions in light of the current extent of health issues associated with ambient air pollution in the region. In particular, results presented here point to policies that increase the share of renewable energy as a potentially effective emissions abatement strategy as policymakers in the region attempt to steer a path towards sustainable development.
abstract_zh: 东南亚是世界上工业化和城市化速度最快的地区之一。这一发展为该地区带来了经济利益，但也带来了与空气污染相关的大量环境和健康影响。本研究首次对东南亚的环境库兹涅茨曲线（EKC）进行了空间计量评估。空间面板在涉及地理单元的研究中十分重要，但迄今为止在许多EKC研究中仍未得到充分利用。本研究通过标准EKC模型和空间EKC模型，考察了三种大气污染物（氮氧化物NOx、二氧化硫SO2和细颗粒物PM2.5）的收入—污染轨迹，模型以人均排放量为因变量，对若干社会经济指标进行回归。计量评估使用了1993年至2012年间九个经济发展水平各异的东南亚国家的数据。所有污染物均呈现倒U形曲线，从而证实了EKC的存在。氮氧化物排放不存在空间溢出效应，而二氧化硫和PM2.5排放则存在空间溢出效应的支持证据。尽管EKC得到支持，但大多数国家仍处于倒U形曲线的上升段。鉴于该地区环境空气污染所造成的健康问题的严重程度，这突显出亟需建立并执行有效的政策以减少排放。特别是，本文结果表明，提高可再生能源份额的政策可能是一种有效的减排策略，有助于该地区的决策者朝着可持续发展的道路迈进。

title: Severe Air Pollution and Labor Productivity: Evidence from Industrial Towns in China
abstract:
We examine day-to-day fluctuations in worker-level output at two manufacturing sites in China. Ambient fine-particle (PM2.5) pollution is severe but significantly variable, largely due to exogenous atmospheric ventilation. We obtain an insignificant immediate output response from concurrent (same-shift) variation in particle pollution. We then allow worker outcomes to respond to day-to-day variation in pollution with up to 30 days of delay. We uncover statistically significant adverse output effects from more prolonged exposure, but effects are not large. A substantial + 10 μg/m
3
PM2.5 variation sustained over 25 days reduces daily output by 1 percent. (JEL J24, O13, P23, P25, P28, Q51, Q53)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了中国两个制造业基地工人个体产出的日常波动。周边细颗粒物（PM2.5）污染严重，但变化显著，很大程度上源于外生的大气通风条件。同一班次内颗粒物污染的同步变化，对产出没有显著的即时影响。随后，我们允许工人产出对长达30天滞后的日间污染变化作出反应。我们发现，较长时间的暴露会产生统计上显著的不利产出效应，但效应并不大。持续25天的+10 μg/m³ PM2.5大幅变化，会使日产出减少1%。（JEL J24, O13, P23, P25, P28, Q51, Q53）

title: Electrical appliances moderate households’ water demand response to heat
abstract: Analysis of potentially interconnected residential water and energy demand is sparse. In a 1-in-10 random sample of Singapore households living in apartments, water use per capita declines over the socioeconomic distribution, whereas electricity use rises. Here I show that in this leading Asian city and tropical climate, water and electricity demand respond differentially to heat across different socioeconomic groups. When temperatures rise, water demand increases among lower-income households but remains unchanged among higher-income households. In sharp contrast, heat induces larger shifts in electricity demand among higher-income households. With air-conditioner penetration ranging from 14 to 99% across different socioeconomic groups, my interpretation is that water provides heat relief for households that have yet to adopt air conditioning. How Singaporeans’ resource demands respond to heat at different income levels can inform the future responses of a vast urban population on rising incomes living in the water-stressed tropics, in similar and warming climates.
abstract_zh: 对可能相互关联的住宅用水与用电需求的分析尚属罕见。在新加坡公寓住户的1/10随机样本中，人均用水量随社会经济分布而下降，而用电量则上升。本文表明，在这一亚洲领先城市及热带气候条件下，用水和用电需求对高温的反应在不同社会经济群体之间存在差异。气温升高时，低收入家庭的用水需求增加，而高收入家庭则保持不变。与此形成鲜明对比的是，高温使高收入家庭的用电需求发生更大的变化。空调普及率在不同社会经济群体之间介于14%至99%，据此我的解释是，水为尚未安装空调的家庭提供了降温的途径。新加坡居民的资源需求在不同收入水平上如何响应高温，可以为未来处于水资源紧张的热带地区以及气候类似、正在变暖的地区，收入不断提高的庞大城市人口的反应提供参考。

Reduced ultrafine particle levels in São Paulo’s atmosphere during shifts from gasoline to ethanol use
abstract: Despite ethanol’s penetration into urban transportation, observational evidence quantifying the consequence for the atmospheric particulate burden during actual, not hypothetical, fuel-fleet shifts, has been lacking. Here we analyze aerosol, meteorological, traffic, and consumer behavior data and find, empirically, that ambient number concentrations of 7–100-nm diameter particles rise by one-third during the morning commute when higher ethanol prices induce 2 million drivers in the real-world megacity of São Paulo to substitute to gasoline use (95% confidence intervals: +4,154 to +13,272 cm−3). Similarly, concentrations fall when consumers return to ethanol. Changes in larger particle concentrations, including US-regulated PM2.5, are statistically indistinguishable from zero. The prospect of increased biofuel use and mounting evidence on ultrafines’ health effects make our result acutely policy relevant, to be weighed against possible ozone increases. The finding motivates further studies in real-world environments. We innovate in using econometrics to quantify a key source of urban ultrafine particles.
abstract_zh: 尽管乙醇已进入城市交通领域，但迄今缺乏观测证据来量化实际（而非假设的）燃料车队转换期间，其对大气颗粒物负荷的影响。本文分析了气溶胶、气象、交通和消费者行为数据，并以实证方式发现：当乙醇价格上涨，促使圣保罗这一现实超大城市中的200万名驾驶人转而使用汽油时，早高峰通勤期间7至100纳米直径颗粒物的环境数量浓度上升了三分之一（95%置信区间：+4,154至+13,272 cm⁻³）。同样，当消费者转回使用乙醇时，浓度随之下降。较大颗粒物的浓度变化，包括美国法规规定的PM2.5，在统计上与零没有显著差异。生物燃料使用的增加，以及关于超细颗粒物健康效应的证据日益增多，使我们的结果在政策上极具相关性，需要与可能出现的臭氧增加进行权衡。这一发现促使人们在现实环境中开展进一步研究。我们创新性地运用计量经济学方法，量化了城市超细颗粒物的一个关键来源。

title: Severe Air Pollution and School Absences: Longitudinal Data on Expatriates in North China
abstract: Little is known about how children of high-income expatriate families, often from rich nations, adapt to temporary residence in a severely polluted city of the developing world. We use a six-year panel of 6,500 students at three international schools in a major city in north China to estimate how fluctuation in ambient PM2.5 over the preceding fortnight impacts daily absences. Our preferred estimates are based on the exclusion restriction that absences respond to atmospheric ventilation such as thermal inversions only through ventilation's effect on particle levels.A large and rare 100 to 200 ?g/m3 shift in average PM2.5 in the prior week raises the incidence of absences by 1 percentage point, about one-quarter of the sample mean. We find stronger responses for US/Canada nationals than among Chinese nationals, and among students who generally miss school the most. Overall responses are mod-est compared to the effect on absences from more moderate in-sample variation in pollution estimated for the US using aggregate data. Using school absence patterns as a window into short-run health and behavior, our study suggests that high-income families find ways to adapt, likely by moving life indoors, even if temporary residence in north China comes at the expense of long-term health.
abstract_zh: 人们对于来自富裕国家的高收入外籍家庭子女，如何适应在发展中国家严重污染城市的暂时居住，所知甚少。我们利用华北一座大城市三所国际学校6,500名学生的六年面板数据，估计前两周周边环境PM2.5的波动如何影响每日缺勤。我们偏好的估计基于一个排他性约束：缺勤仅通过通风对颗粒物水平的影响而对逆温等大气通风条件作出反应。前一周平均PM2.5出现罕见而巨大的100至200 μg/m³变化，会使缺勤发生率上升1个百分点，约占样本均值的四分之一。我们发现，美国和加拿大籍学生的反应强于中国籍学生，且在平时缺课最多的学生中反应更为明显。总体反应相对适度，与美国基于总量数据、利用样本内较温和的污染变化所估计的缺勤效应相比，要小得多。以学生缺勤模式作为观察短期健康和行为的窗口，我们的研究表明，高收入家庭会设法适应，可能是通过将生活转入室内，即便暂时居住在华北的代价是长期健康受损。

Reduction in local ozone levels in urban São Paulo due to a shift from ethanol to gasoline use
abstract: It has been proposed that lower NOx emission fuels such as ethanol can mitigate air pollution from vehicles burning oil-based hydrocarbons. Yet, existing modeling and laboratory studies, even those seeking to simulate the same environment, vary in their predictions of how gasoline/ethanol blends affect atmospheric pollutant concentrations, including ozone. Importantly, ambient concentrations have not been evaluated during an actual – as opposed to hypothetical – shift in fuel mix in a real-world environment. Here, we report the first such study, for the subtropical megacity of São Paulo, Brazil. We combine detailed street-hour level data on regulated pollutant concentrations, meteorology, and traffic with fuel shares from a consumer demand model to compare concentrations across subsamples that differ only in the fuel mix but are otherwise similar in meteorology, anthropogenic activity, and biogenic emissions. As the gasoline share of the bi-fuel light-duty vehicle fleet rose by 62 percentage points, we estimate a robust and statistically significant reduction of about 20% in ozone concentrations, and less precise increases in NO and CO concentrations. We propose that our “model-free” analysis potentially accounts for the interaction between anthropogenic and biogenic emissions and caution that successful strategies against ozone pollution require knowledge of the local chemistry and analysis beyond the presently monitored pollutants, most notably fine particles.
abstract_zh: 有观点认为，乙醇等氮氧化物排放较低的燃料，可以减轻以石油类碳氢化合物为燃料的车辆所造成的空气污染。然而，现有的建模和实验室研究，即便是试图模拟同一环境的研究，对汽油/乙醇混合燃料如何影响大气污染物浓度（包括臭氧）的预测也存在分歧。重要的是，在真实环境中，尚未对实际（而非假设的）燃料构成转换期间的环境浓度进行过评估。在此，我们报告了针对巴西圣保罗这一亚热带超大城市的首次此类研究。我们将街道—小时级别的规制污染物浓度、气象和交通数据，与消费者需求模型得出的燃料份额相结合，比较了仅燃料构成不同、而在气象、人为活动和生物源排放上基本相似的子样本的浓度。随着双燃料轻型车辆车队中汽油份额上升62个百分点，我们估计臭氧浓度显著且稳健地下降了约20%，而NO和CO浓度则有所上升，但估计精度较低。我们提出，这一“无模型”分析可能捕捉到了人为排放与生物源排放之间的相互作用，并告诫说，要成功制定臭氧污染防治策略，需要了解当地化学过程，并分析目前监测的污染物之外的物质，尤其是细颗粒物。

Is Arbitrage Tying the Price of Ethanol to that of Gasoline? Evidence from the Uptake of Flexible-Fuel Technology
abstract: As much of the world goes searching for alternative sources of energy to oil, Brazil's three-decade experience in developing a successful substitute for gasoline merits attention. Brazil is the only sizable economy to date to have developed a ubiquitously distributed alternative to oil-based fuels in road transportation: ethanol from sugarcane. Perhaps unsurprisingly, the uptake of flexible-fuel (dual-fuel) vehicle technology has been tremendous. We provide a stylized model of the vertical sugar industry which incorporates arbitrage by producers, across domestic and export markets for ethanol and sugar, and arbitrage by consumers, across ethanol and gasoline at the pump. We show that the model stands up well to the empirical covariation in prices over 30 years. In particular, owing to the increasing penetration of flexible-fuel vehicles, consumer arbitrage is tying the retail price of ethanol to that of gasoline. Of relevance to the current "food-versus-fuel" debate, the outward shift of the ethanol demand curve, at price levels where traditional gasoline consumers arbitrage, may lead to higher sugar prices, thanks to substitution in demand (gasoline and ethanol) and in supply (sugar and ethanol).
abstract_zh: 随着世界各地都在寻找替代石油的能源，巴西在三十年间开发汽油替代品的成功经验值得关注。巴西是迄今为止唯一一个在道路运输中普遍供应石油基燃料替代品的重要经济体：以甘蔗为原料生产的乙醇。或许并不令人意外，双燃料（灵活燃料）汽车技术的普及程度相当可观。我们提供了一个简化的垂直制糖行业模型，其中纳入了生产者在国内和出口市场（乙醇与食糖）之间的套利，以及消费者在加油站乙醇与汽油之间的套利。我们表明，该模型能够很好地拟合三十年来价格的实际共同变动。特别是，由于灵活燃料汽车的普及率不断提高，消费者套利正使乙醇的零售价格与汽油挂钩。与当前的“粮食与燃料之争”相关的是，在传统汽油消费者进行套利的价格水平上，乙醇需求曲线的外移，可能会因需求端（汽油与乙醇之间）和供给端（食糖与乙醇之间）的替代而推高糖价。
